units.function: Create a short visual pause around one small light source without spiritualizing it.
mechanics: Sit close together.
Look softly at a small flame or light.
Notice changes/flicker in the light.
Breathe calmly while watching.
immutable_facts: The source permits either a small flame or another light source.
Luli comments on letting the eyes rest.
character_roles: Luli is observant, dry and slightly self-aware.
safety_claim_boundaries: Do not claim the light changes emotion or energy.
If a real candle is used, keep it safely positioned and supervised.
units.tone_job: Simple visual focus, not meditation language.
units.humor_room: Luli can joke about not analysing everything for once.

units.function: Run a voice-imitation circle where one sentence travels around in different voices.
mechanics: Starter is the person with the longest hair.
Starter says one cheerful sentence in a normal voice.
Move anticlockwise.
Each person repeats the same sentence in a different voice/tone.
No voice repeats within a round.
After a full round, the person to the starter's right chooses a new sentence for another round.
immutable_facts: Voice examples may be culturally adapted.
Mimi warns about choosing a voice you will immediately hear repeated.
character_roles: Mimi is practical and amused by foreseeable family chaos.
safety_claim_boundaries: Keep it vocal/playful; do not add unsafe physical actions.
units.tone_job: Quick imitation game with escalating absurdity.
units.humor_room: Joke about having to hear your chosen voice repeated around the room.
units.cultural_friction: Replace dated/awkward English voice examples with durable Polish-friendly ones.

units.function: Ask each person to choose one color that matches their day.
mechanics: Each person chooses one color.
Each says the color aloud.
immutable_facts: Invented colors are allowed.
Dilo explicitly approves invented colors.
character_roles: Dilo treats invented categories like a system feature.
safety_claim_boundaries: Do not imply colors diagnose emotions.
units.tone_job: Very short, creative check-in without explanation pressure.
units.humor_room: Dilo can 'add' a new color to the system.

units.function: Spend one minute listening to sounds at three distances/intensities.
mechanics: Close eyes.
For one minute notice three layers of sound: near, far, subtle/very quiet.
immutable_facts: Duration is one minute.
Three sound layers are required.
Dilo comments on unusual quiet in his own mind.
safety_claim_boundaries: Do not claim the exercise regulates emotion or produces calm.
units.tone_job: Listening game more than mindfulness exercise.
units.humor_room: Dilo can joke about browser tabs/mental noise.

units.function: Build a human counting clock with pointing, speed/reverse rounds and an advanced no-order round.
mechanics: Sit in a circle.
Tallest person starts with 1 and points to someone.
Pointed person says 2 and points onward; continue to 12.
Any mistake resets to the start.
Repeat faster.
Repeat backward from 12 to 1.
Optional higher target number.
Advanced: group counts to 12 or higher without pre-agreeing who starts or who says next; if two speak together, restart.
Two-person version remains valid.
immutable_facts: Numbers 1-12 and reverse 12-1 are core.
Advanced round has no preassigned order.
Dilo frames precision like a strict system.
safety_claim_boundaries: Keep pointing and pace safe; no elimination/shaming.
units.tone_job: Fast coordination challenge with clean rules.
units.humor_room: A VAR/reset joke can fit Dilo.

units.function: Name one familiar home sound each person genuinely likes hearing.
mechanics: Each person names one sound they like hearing at home.
immutable_facts: The sound may be ordinary.
Dilo jokes about tech/appliance sounds.
character_roles: Dilo notices domestic sounds through a tech/snack lens.
safety_claim_boundaries: Do not claim the sound proves safety or attachment.
units.tone_job: Everyday home detail, not sentimental reflection.
units.cultural_friction: Avoid saying home is 'built from sounds that make us feel safe'.

units.function: Create a short shared breathing rhythm in a loose circle without mystical shared-breath framing.
mechanics: Sit in a loose circle.
Hands rest on own knees or are lightly joined if everyone wants.
Breathe for a short while at a similar pace.
immutable_facts: Original uses a shared-breath/wave image.
Alio frames it as teamwork in quiet form.
character_roles: Alio is team-oriented and lightly chaotic.
safety_claim_boundaries: Do not claim one breath literally moves through everyone.
units.humor_room: Alio can joke that the team is working without a meeting.

units.function: Run a three-round synchronized balance/movement challenge with age-based leaders.
mechanics: Stand shoulder-to-shoulder in a row.
Round 1: youngest leads while participating; calls gentle lean forward/back/left/right; goal at least 10 group moves without mistake.
Round 2: next person in age order leads small synchronized steps forward/back/right/left; goal at least 15 moves without mistake.
Final round: oldest leads mixed leans and single/multiple steps at varied pace; play as long as desired.
immutable_facts: Round goals 10 and 15 are required.
Leader order: youngest, next in age order, oldest.
Luli warns against dramatic falling.
safety_claim_boundaries: Movements must stay small/safe; no deliberate falling or loss of balance.
units.cultural_friction: Avoid translating 'balance grows when we share direction'.

units.function: Share words or short phrases each person likes hearing from family when upset or overwhelmed.
mechanics: Each person names one specific word/phrase they like hearing from family members when they need to settle.
immutable_facts: The point is preferred family language, not universal calming advice.
Luli contrasts gentle wording with something harsh.
safety_claim_boundaries: Do not claim a phrase will calm everyone.
units.tone_job: Practical family communication with no therapy jargon.
units.humor_room: Luli can dismiss the need for wise-sounding phrases.
units.cultural_friction: Avoid feather/thunderbolt metaphor unless a Polish equivalent truly works.

units.function: Let the body rest on the floor/chair and notice physical support.
mechanics: Sit or lie near each other.
Let the body rest fully.
Notice the floor supporting body weight.
immutable_facts: Dilo jokes that the floor/gravity is doing the lifting.
units.tone_job: Physical reset with a concrete joke.

units.function: Pass a smile around the circle, then repeat with different friendly gestures; preserve consent and two-person version.
mechanics: Stand or sit in a circle.
Person with shortest hair starts by smiling at one chosen person.
Smile travels person to person and returns to starter after reaching everyone.
Round 2: high-five.
Round 3: gentle shoulder tap.
Round 4: quick hug only if comfortable/wanted.
Two people: smile at each other for 30 seconds; then hug for another 30 seconds only if both want.
immutable_facts: Starter has shortest hair.
Smile chain must reach everyone and return.
Two 30-second intervals exist in two-person version.
Nini says bigger smiles travel better.
units.humor_room: Nini can encourage an oversized smile.
units.cultural_friction: Avoid claims that smiles become 'powerful' or 'amplified'.

units.function: Notice one family member who often helps quietly without seeking attention.
mechanics: Each person names one family member who often helps/supports others without drawing attention.
Say what they noticed that person doing.
immutable_facts: Focus is on quiet, often-unnoticed help.
Nini says quiet heroes do not brag.
safety_claim_boundaries: Do not moralize or require praise of a specific person.
units.humor_room: Nini can say that if they do not brag, the family can do it for them.
